description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class named EmployeeTimeAtWorkServiceTest for testing the EmployeeTimeAtWorkService within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It sets up test data, mocks required services, and includes test methods that verify the calculation of employee work times over specified periods.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkServiceTest
